newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey kills 46 Kurdish rebels in southeast.
newsitem.headline: Turkey kills 46 Kurdish rebels in southeast.

text.p: Turkish security forces have killed 46 Kurdish rebels in the last two days in clashes in eastern Turkey, the emergency rule governor's office said in a statement on Sunday.
The statement said that 33 guerillas of the separatist Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) were killed in the remote mountains of Tunceli province, with another 10 rebels killed in Batman province.
Three others were killed in separate clashes in the provinces of Van and Siirt, the statement said.

Military sources in Tunceli said about 50 PKK members were encircled early on Saturday near the town of Cemisgezek in an operation backed by tanks, U.S.-made Cobra helicopter gunships and some 3,000 troops.
Twenty rebels were killed on Saturday and a further 13 killed in the continuing clashes on Sunday, the sources said. One wounded rebel was captured, they said.
More than 22,000 people have died in the struggle between the Turkish armed forces and the PKK who are fighting for independence or autonomy in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
